map.靠 source map。构建时生成 .map 并在产物末尾保留 //# sou: With a source map. Generate a .map file at build time and keep the //# sourceMappingURL comment at the end of the output; the browser and error-monitoring platforms can then map back to the original file names and line numbers. Do not deploy the map file publicly, or your source is effectively public.
map.JavaScript 简化器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏: JavaScript Minifier. An online tool built for developers, running entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.先做词法切分：依次识别单行注释 //、块注释 /* */、字符串（含模板串中 $: Lex first: recognize line comments //, block comments /* */, strings (including ${} brace pairing inside templates), regexes (decide by the previous meaningful token whether / is division or a regex start: after identifiers or numbers it is usually division, while after keywords such as return/typeof/in/of/instanceof/new/delete/void/case/throw/else/do/yield/await and operators it is a regex), numbers (including hex and scientific notation, with +/− folded in only after e/E), identifiers, and keywords. Minification rules: removing comments keeps one newline for line comments to avoid merging lines; whitespace folding first collapses runs into a space, then removes spaces around semicolons and operators while keeping required spaces between keywords and following identifiers; booleans simplify true → !0 and false → !1; numbers drop a leading 0 (0.5 → .5). Compression ratio = (1 − output length ÷ input length) × 100%, 0 when the input length is 0.
